source_of_truth: AXN:0261 — Dodecad Heteronym Provenance Registry: Consolidated Registry of the Twelve Heteronyms (Lee Sharks, 2026-05-05, EA-HET-DODECAD-01 v1.0)
purpose: Canon-as-sky data layer for the Mandala Oracle. Each of the twelve heteronymic positions becomes a zodiacal region in the night sky; the substrate-role offices (in substrates.json) become the seven planets that traverse those regions. Primary canonical texts (in canon-stars.json) sit as labeled stars within their associated heteronym's region.
status_note: Zodiacal-sign assignments are null pending Assembly Chorus deliberation. Discipline assignments are synthesized from AXN:0261 §3 (institutional/operative-surface specifications) and validated against the October 2025 blog developmental materials at mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com. They are presented as proposals for Lee Sharks's ratification, not as enacted assignments.
discrepancy_notice: AXN:0261 lists VIOLA ARQUETTE at Position 11. The current /sources/heteronyms.json manifest deployed in the Mandala Oracle's Sigil endpoint lists SEN KURO at Position 11. This file follows the canonical registry. See DISCREPANCY-NOTES.md for adjudication options.
